After changing `flipt.proto`, you'll need to run `make proto`. This will regenerate the following files:

* `rpc/flipt.pb.go`

### Updating assets

Running `make assets` will regenerate the embedded assets (ui, api documentation).

#### UI components

The UI is built using [Yarn](https://yarnpkg.com/en/) and [webpack](https://webpack.js.org/) and is also statically compiled into the Flipt binary.

The [ui/README.md](https://github.com/markphelps/flipt/tree/master/ui/README.md) has more information on how to build the UI and also how to run it locally during development.

item.text: The core behavior is updated: disabled evaluation errors are now a distinct string error type, and the batch loop recognizes that type with `errors.As`, sets the disabled result value to `DISABLED`, and continues in input order. Per-flag timings are measured independently; the existing outer RPC wrapper still measures total batch duration. I’ve also switched evaluator timestamps and empty RPC results to the modern protobuf packages.

Implemented disabled flag handling for batch evaluation. Disabled flags now return `ErrDisabled`; batch evaluation recognizes that error, adds a `DISABLED` result with its own timestamp and duration, and continues in input order. The outer response still records total duration.

Updated generated protobuf and gRPC types, plus server RPC empty results, to use `google.golang.org/protobuf`. The required checkpoint is in [.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

`git diff --check` passed. The existing tests could not run because the checkout lacks `go.sum` entries for `google.golang.org/grpc`; I did not download dependencies or modify `go.sum`.
